author: Shoto_
body: It's annoying seeing players spamming the chat saying "OMFG SO-SO HACKS TURN THEM OFF NOOB" so everytime a player says "hacks" paired with a player name, it says "Use /report instead of publicly accusing a player of hacks. Thanks!" Or something along the lines. Also, it'll help if there are broadcasts of using /report, so players can learn about the command.

It should be something like:

Use /report if you suspect someone is hacking. Public accusations can result in a punishment.

+1 for public broadcasts

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
actually it is allowed to say people are hacking, it is not against the rules, the rules are that you are not allowed to spam/use caps on it

ex:

OMG YOU HACKER

HACKER

HACKER

REPORT MLGPORKY, HE IS A HACKER

doing that is against the rules ^
but saying it a few times (in caps too) is allowed
by a few times I mean once or twice
